$comment: Shared neo-brutalist design tokens for the iPhone app (ios/) and the Windows helper (windows/). Values match windows/src/Missie.Desktop/Theme/Brutal.xaml. Change them here first, then in both apps.
name: Ruben on Mission · brutal

accentFor.$comment: Which accent a section, area or collection uses, so a thing has the same colour on both apps.

shadow.$comment: Hard offset shadow: a solid ink shape behind, never a blur. Pressed buttons move by the offset and lose the shadow.

font.$comment: Familjen Grotesk is the website font (website/fonts). Fall back to the platform's bold sans.

components.tileCard: Folder-tab card: an accent-coloured tab on top-left with the title, paper body, ink outline, hard shadow. Holds an icon square (accent fill, ink outline) and a big count.
components.iconButton: Square, paper fill, ink outline, small hard shadow, ink icon.
components.primaryButton: Yellow fill, ink outline, hard shadow, bold label. Pressed: moves by the shadow offset, shadow gone.
components.addButton: Big round or square yellow + button, ink outline and hard shadow.
components.chip: Pill, accent fill at full strength, ink outline (thin), bold caption text.
